# `aitbc grant vote`

Cast a vote for, against, or abstain on a grant proposal.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc grant vote [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--grant-id` | text | — | yes | The Grant id. |
| `--vote` | choice | — | yes | Vote choice |
| `--voting-power` | float | `0.0` | no | Voting power |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc grant vote --grant-id <grant_id> --vote <vote>
```
